title: AmazingJoin
description: This plugin allows to execute actions when a player joins or leaves.
body:
# AmazingJoin

Want to change the horrible yellow vanilla message when a player joins? **AmazingJoin is your saviour!**

## Information
- This plugin allows the server to execute specific actions when the player joins. There are **15** possible actions you can use to boost your server's joining experience. 
  
- This **Amazing** plugin is officialy tested in PaperMC, PurpurMC and Pufferfish. **SPIGOT IS NOT SUPPORTED.** You can always try out the plugin in other forks!

- It supports 1.21.4 and above.

- You can hook it with AuthMe and nLogin.

- You can create actions that only execute under certain conditions! Check the wiki to know more! 

- MiniMessage formatting full support. Legacy is not supported.

- PlaceholderAPI support.
  
## Help and support
If you need help configuring the plugin, you need to firstly check the plugin [wiki](https://cubicdev.gitbook.io/amazingjoin). To report issues, you can go to the [github repository](https://github.com/CubicLemming749/AmazingJoin_renewed) and open an issue. Also, you can reach me personally trough Discord (User: elsus1719) for issues and suggests.
